canvas.responsive: uniform contain scale with letterboxing; invert letterbox transform before hit tests

known_art_issues: Some decorative book rows do not sit exactly on architecture shelf edges; furnishings need a final alignment pass.
Warm candle illumination is baked into static decorations; exterior switching alone does not relight the interior.
Room opaque regions have near-opaque alpha (max 254) from generator, allowing slight backdrop bleed.
No alternate lid-open chest, gargoyle pose, dragon skeletal rig, separate armillary rings, or wizard hand poses supplied.
